text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Ugh... Its magic. I can feel it stronger than before...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うう……
あいつの魔力。
さっきよりも強く感じるわ……！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: Kyaru-chi, you're trembling, but are you okay...? I'll lend you my cape!
text_block_list.orig_text:
キャルっち
震えてるけど
だいじょーぶ……？
うちのケープ貸したげるよ！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: ...It's fine, can't you also feel the cold? Even if you can't use magic, you should feel this chill...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……いいわよ、
あんたも寒気を感じるでしょ？
いくらあんたが魔法を使えなくても、
この冷気は感じるはずじゃ……

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: Huh, really, I'm fine. I'm wearing a gym uniform under my uniform.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん、
マジでへーき。
うち
制服の下に
体操服着こんでるから。

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: Huh, why are you so surprised?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん、
そんな驚くとこ？

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Well... wearing a gym uniform underneath and still looking like that, it's impressive for a supermodel...
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや……
下に体操服着ててそのスタイルって、
スーパーモデル恐るべしと思って……

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: ...No time for that now. Let's hurry up and catch that thing!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……いや
そんなん言ってる場合じゃないわ。
さっさとやつを追うわよ！
